mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6.5% in a 3-month period, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 6.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have declined in the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), aggressive monetary tightening is anticipated, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000, it signals a slowing labor market that precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS < 50000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates economic contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST have declined in the prior quarter, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market downturn (HOUST < 1500) and weak retail sales (RSAFS < 530000), the economy enters demand contraction phase, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 530000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
